items.title: 15.5 Young ka double slit tajurba (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation, paragraph for paragraph with the English (book) lesson.

blocks.text: Ab hum us mashhoor tajurbe ko qareeb se dekhte hain jo Thomas Young ne 1801 mein kiya. Is tajurbe se unhon ne roshni ka wave hona dikhaya. Roshni ki aik shua (beam) do mutawazi (parallel) slits par dali jati hai jo shua ke perpendicular rakhi hoti hain. Roshni har slit se diffract ho kar (mur kar) aage ki jagah mein phailti hai, aur dono slits ki roshni screen par aik doosre ke oopar aati hai. Screen par roshan aur andhere patton ka interference pattern banta hai; in patton ko 'fringes' kehte hain.

Interference dekhne ke liye lehron ke do sets chahiye. Lehron ke sources coherent hone chahiye, yani sources se nikalne wali lehron ka phase difference constant rahe. Is ka matlab yeh bhi hai ke lehron ki wavelength aik jaisi ho. Aaj kal yeh aasani se hota hai: laser ki aik hi shua ko do slits se guzaar dein. Laser tez aur coherent roshni deta hai. Slits se guzarte hue roshni diffract ho kar aage phail jati hai (Fig. 15.8). Ab hamare paas lehron ke do sets hain jo aik doosre ke oopar aate hain, aur screen par fringes ka pattern un ke interference ka nateeja dikhata hai. Yeh pattern kaise banta hai? Hum screen ke teen points lete hain (Fig. 15.9 a, b, c) aur dekhte hain ke har point par kya nazar aana chahiye.

blocks.alt: Baen taraf teen khare wavefronts jinhein chaar ufqi gulabi shuaein (rays) kaatti hain, aur yeh do slits S1 aur S2 wali rukawat tak pohanchti hain. Rukawat ke paar har slit se gol wavefronts phailte aur daen taraf screen ki taraf jate hue aik doosre ko kaat-te hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 15.8: Double slit ka intizam (kitab mein Fig. 15.9 chhapa; kitab ki figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Kitab is figure ko 'Fig.15.9' likhti hai, lekin matan isi ko Fig 15.8 kehta hai aur agli teen hisson wali figure ko Fig 15.9. Is liye yahan isay Figure 15.8 likha hai. Har slit naye source ki tarah gol lehrein chhorti hai; jahan dono ki lehrein milti hain wahan interference hota hai.
Point A

Yeh point dono slits ke beech wale point ke bilkul samne hai. A par roshni ki do shuaein pohanchti hain, aik slit 1 se aur aik slit 2 se. A dono slits se barabar faasle par hai, is liye dono shuaon ne barabar faasla tay kiya. Dono ka path difference (raste ki lambai ka farq) sifar hai. Agar slits se nikalte waqt dono in phase thin to A par bhi in phase pohanchengi. Is liye constructive interference hoga aur A par roshan fringe nazar aayega.
Point B

Yeh point A se thora sa hat kar hai aur pehle andhere fringe ka beech (midpoint) hai. B par bhi har slit se aik aik shua pohanchti hai. Slit 1 ki roshni ko slit 2 ki roshni se thora zyada faasla tay karna parta hai, is liye dono shuaein ab qadam se qadam nahi milatin. B andhere fringe ke beech mein hai, is liye dono shuaein antiphase mein hain (phase difference 180°). Dono ka path difference aadhi wavelength hai, is liye destructive interference hota hai.
Point C

Yeh agle roshan fringe ka beech hai, aur AB = BC. Yahan bhi shua 1 ne shua 2 se zyada faasla tay kiya; is dafa yeh izafi faasla poori aik wavelength λ hai. Ab path difference aik poori wavelength hai, is liye dono shuaein screen par in phase hain. Constructive interference hota hai aur roshan fringe nazar aata hai. Poora interference pattern isi tarah samjhaya ja sakta hai (Fig. 15.9).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab yahan 'Fig.15.21' ka hawala deti hai jo kitab mein maujood hi nahi. Points A, B aur C ke roshan aur andhere hisse Fig. 15.9 mein dikhaye gaye hain.

blocks.alt: Teen hisse; har aik mein d faasle par slits S1 aur S2, L faasle par screen, aur dono slits se lehardaar shuaein. (a) Shuaein screen ke markaz par milti hain: roshan (constructive interference). (b) Oopar milti hain; neeche wali shua aadhi wavelength zyada chalti hai (surmai tikon): andhera (destructive). (c) Mazeed oopar, aik poori wavelength zyada: roshan. Zawiya theta dikhaya gaya.
blocks.caption: Figure 15.9: (a) θ = 0 par markazi roshan hissa; (b) pehla andhera hissa; (c) pehle darje ka roshan hissa (kitab ki Figure 15.9 ke mutabiq asal khaaka; kitab mein (b) aur (c) ke captions ulat gaye hain).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ki Fig. 15.9 ke captions mein panel (b) ko 'first order bright region' aur panel (c) ko 'first dark region' likha hai, lekin khaake ulat dikhate hain: (b) mein izafi faasla aadhi wavelength (andhera, destructive) aur (c) mein poori aik wavelength (roshan, constructive) hai. Upar caption sahi likha gaya hai.

Young ke tajurbe ka hisaab aasan karne ke liye farz karte hain ke slits se screen tak faasla L slits ke darmiyani faasle d ke muqable mein itna bara hai ke S₁ aur S₂ se point P tak jane wali lakeerein taqreeban parallel hain. Roshni ke tajurbat mein aam taur par aisa hi hota hai: slits ka faasla chand millimetre ya is se kam hota hai, jab ke screen aik metre ya zyada door hoti hai. Phir raste ki lambai ka farq (path difference) yeh hai:
Yahan θ woh angle hai jo slits se screen tak jane wali lakeer aur slits ki satah ke normal (perpendicular lakeer) ke darmiyan banta hai.
Do slits ka constructive aur destructive interference

Hum parh chuke hain ke constructive interference (lehron ka mazboot hona) un points par hota hai jahan path difference wavelength ka poora adad (integer) guna ho, yani mλ, jahan m = 0, 1, 2, 3. Is liye screen par roshan hisse (Fig. 15.10) un angles θ par bante hain jin ke liye:

Isi tarah destructive interference (lehron ka khatam hona) un points par hota hai jahan path difference aadha-adad (half-integer), yani (m + ½) wavelengths ho. Wahan screen par andhere hisse bante hain:
Is tarah screen par roshan aur andhere patton ka silsila banta hai, jinhein interference fringes kehte hain; yeh slits S₁ aur S₂ ke parallel hote hain (Fig. 15.9).

blocks.alt: Surmai rukawat mein do slits, oopar S2 aur neeche S1, d faasle par, aur daen taraf L faasle par screen. Neeli shuaein r2 aur r1 slits se screen ke nuqte P tak jati hain jo markazi lakeer se y neeche hai. Markazi lakeer aur shua ke darmiyan zawiya theta, aur slits par bhi theta; S2 wali shua ka chhota izafi hissa d sin theta likha hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 15.10: Double slit ke intizam ka khaaka (kitab ki Figure 15.10 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Ab hum screen par roshan patton ke markazon (centres) ki jagah ka formula nikalte hain. Fig. 15.10 mein y pattern ke markaz se napa jata hai. Farz karein yₘ pattern ke markaz (θ = 0) se m-wein roshan patti ke markaz tak ka faasla hai, aur θₘ is ka angle hai. To:
Aise tajurbat mein yₘ aam taur par L se bohat chhota hota hai. Is liye θₘ bohat chhota angle hai, aur chhote angle ke liye sin θₘ taqreeban tan θₘ ke barabar hota hai. Is liye:
Ab d sin θₘ = mλ (equation 15.2) se sin θₘ = mλ/d rakhein. Chhote angles ke liye m-wein roshan patti ki jagah:
Do lagatar (consecutive) roshan ya do lagatar andhere fringes ke markazon ka faasla (fringe spacing):

Pattern mein do saath wale roshan patton ka faasla slits ke faasle d ke inversely proportional (ulat tanasub) hai: d chhota to Δy bara. Slits jitni qareeb hon, pattern utna phailta hai; slits door hon to patte qareeb qareeb aa jate hain.

Humne yeh tajurba Young ki tarah nazar aane wali roshni ke saath bayan kiya, lekin yeh equations har qism ki wave par laagu hain, shart yeh hai ke do coherent sources ki resultant lehar aise point par pakri jaye jo slits ke faasle d ke muqable mein bohat door ho.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Kitab sin θₘ = tan θₘ likhti hai; yeh sirf chhote angles ke liye taqreeban (approximately) sahi hai. Kitab ke 'ssmall' aur 'cosective' ka matlab 'small' aur 'consecutive' (lagatar) hai.
Hal shuda misal (izafi, kitab ki nahi)

blocks.title: Izafi misal
blocks.problem: 600 nm wavelength ki roshni 0.30 mm faasle wali do slits se guzarti hai aur fringes 1.5 m door screen par dekhe jate hain. Fringe spacing Δy maloom karein.
steps: Diya gaya: λ = 600 nm = 600 × 10⁻⁹ m, d = 0.30 mm = 0.30 × 10⁻³ m, L = 1.5 m; maloom karna hai Δy.

blocks.prompt: Slits ke faasle d aur screen ke faasle L se fringes ka faasla y banta hai. Agar d aur L dono dugne kar diye jayen to fringes ka naya faasla kya hoga?
blocks.explanation: y hi rahega: Δy = Lλ/d, aur L aur d dono dugne karne se Lλ/d nahi badalta.

blocks.prompt: Agar Young ka poora saaman pani mein rakh diya jaye to fringes ka kya hoga?
blocks.explanation: Pani mein roshni ki wavelength kam ho jati hai (λ/n, jahan n taqreeban 1.33), is liye fringe spacing Lλ/d ghat jati hai: fringes qareeb qareeb aa jate hain.

blocks.text: Mukhtasar khulasa

items: Point A: path difference sifar, roshan; point B: aadhi wavelength, andhera; point C: poori wavelength, roshan.
Path difference r₂ − r₁ = d sin θ (15.1).
Roshan: d sin θ = mλ (15.2); andhera: d sin θ = (m + ½)λ.
yₘ = L tan θₘ ≈ L sin θₘ = mLλ/d (15.3-15.5); fringe spacing Δy = Lλ/d (15.6), d ke ulat tanasub.
